question: List the five phases of an ordinary turn in order. If one Spirit has finished playing and paying while another is still choosing Growth, may the first begin resolving a Fast Power? Within the Fast Power Phase, must Powers follow player order, or may players choose their sequence?
answer: Spirit Phase, Fast Power Phase, Invader Phase, Slow Power Phase, Time Passes. All Spirits must finish the Spirit Phase before anyone resolves Fast Powers. Within the phase, players may choose Power order, completing one before the next.

question: Assume two Ravage Cards will be resolved in sequence.
